registration: Local protocol fixed before loading real TRAIN targets; no external registration
task: Conditional observed-contrast likelihood diagnostic; true magnitude is an evaluation covariate, not deployed inference
data_scope: TRAIN only; no VAL/TEST files or raw waveform reads
observation: d13=Z13;d15=Z35+max(0,Z13), recovering log10 disjoint-block-peak ratios to first1s peak
baseline: Existing fixed first10post-Psamples; not pre-P noise; positive gain division only, not full response removal
validity: Fit full2D only where original valid[:,1] true, finite Z/labels and unit1/2; preserve all excluded IDs/reasons. Evaluate3s on valid[:,0],5s on valid[:,1]. No threshold or censoring changes
event_split: SHA256(UTF8(salt + U+001F + exact event_id)).digest()[0] & 1; fit fold0 evaluate1 and reverse; same assignment across unit strata
fit_weighting: Equal valid TRAIN event weight within each native-unit stratum; inverse count of included records per event, then normalize total weight to1
evaluation_weighting: Average eligible station-record NLL within each event, then equal event mean within unit; rows retained and event support counts reported
primary_comparison: shared_cap vs independently fitted moment_matched; same-parameter moment_match_from_shared_cap also scored as a counterfactual, not an independently trained arm
cap_mean: b[0:2] + kappa*(min(M,s2+offset)-min(M,s1+offset), min(M,s3+offset)-min(M,s1+offset)); a single state offset is shared across all blocks
noise_covariance: C=0.03^2 I + L L^T, L lower triangular with softplus diagonal; independent of M and cap state; full2x2 residual covariance
moment_match: mu=sum(w*mu_k); covariance=C+sum(w*(mu_k-mu)(mu_k-mu)^T); include full determinant in every Gaussian
linear_reference: Two affine conditional means in M centered at3; same covariance family. Fewer parameters, coarse reference only
initialization: Base caps[3.5,4.2,4.8],kappa1,weights uniform; b initialized to fit-fold weighted residual mean at base curve; C initialized from fit-fold weighted centered residual covariance with eigenvalues floored at0.03^2+1e-6; fixed seeded jitter0.01 on raw parameters. Moment_matched/shared_cap start byte-identical
fit_objective: 5s full2D conditional weighted NLL only; no fitting/selection on held fold. 3s scored from the first-coordinate model marginal,1s has no contrast and identity likelihood1
reporting: event-macro scores at allM,M>=4,M>=4.5,M>=5 when present
all raw per-row log likelihoods,split/identity/mask hashes and parameters
excluded/valid counts and magnitude support per fold/unit
decision: Only earn a later posterior pilot if shared_cap has lower held-event5s jointNLL than refitted moment_matched in both eventfolds and both starts in each unit stratum, pooled paired-bootstrap upper95% difference<0, no3s marginal-NLL deterioration averaged over folds in either start/unit, and noM>=4 conditional-NLL deterioration averaged over folds when at least10held events per unit. Otherwise reject or mark support-inconclusive; never claim magnitude accuracy from this diagnostic
minimum_support: Require>=100fit events and>=30held events per unit/fold; report and skip insufficient strata. Any missing stratum prevents a general two-unit pass
failure_gates: source hash/row count/schema or identity mismatch
uninformative-cap null likelihood depends on M
resource_bound: CPU only,CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty,oneTorch CPU thread; <=30minutes total fit runtime; <=1GiB artifacts; no shared dependency changes
claim_limit: Empirical cap-state density; no identifiable physical rupture/stressdrop/depth state, no new information, no1s result, no real EEW accuracy or novelty claim
